items.quote: “This woman said to me, ‘Give up your son so we may eat him today, and tomorrow we’ll eat my son.’
items.contrast: The first son is the son of the woman speaking to the king, not the other woman’s son.
items.reason: In the reported proposal, the other woman tells the speaker to give up “your son” first and contrasts him with “my son,” who is to be eaten the next day.
